name: campuswatt
description: CampusWatt - AI-ready energy optimisation for smart campuses (MERN)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && node scripts/setup-env.js && npm run generate
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:json: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run start:json" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
